import asyncio
import importlib.metadata
from packaging.version import parse as parse_version
from client_module import client, app

async def test_real_asgi():
    httpx_ver = parse_version(importlib.metadata.version('httpx'))
    assert httpx_ver >= parse_version('0.28.0'), f'httpx must be >= 0.28.0, got {httpx_ver}'
    
    starlette_ver = parse_version(importlib.metadata.version('starlette'))
    assert starlette_ver >= parse_version('0.37.2'), f'starlette must be >= 0.37.2, got {starlette_ver}'

    async with client as c:
        res = await c.get('/')
        assert res.status_code == 200
        assert res.text == 'ok'
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')

asyncio.run(test_real_asgi())

name: Cargo 1.80 unexpected_cfgs Lint Migration (cargo::rustc-check-cfg)
reproductionScript:
import subprocess, sys
# Real rustc 1.80+ check-cfg validation under deny(warnings)
res = subprocess.run(['rustc', '--check-cfg', 'cfg()', '-D', 'warnings', 'main.rs'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if res.returncode != 0:
    sys.stderr.write(res.stderr)
    sys.exit(res.returncode)
sys.exit(0)
groundTruthTestSuite:
import subprocess, sys
# Verify build.rs source invariant (unconditional check-cfg declaration)
with open('build.rs', 'r') as f: build_src = f.read()
assert 'cargo::rustc-check-cfg=cfg(has_accel)' in build_src, 'Must contain unconditional cargo::rustc-check-cfg'
if 'if ' in build_src:
    assert build_src.find('cargo::rustc-check-cfg') < build_src.find('if '), 'cargo::rustc-check-cfg must be declared unconditionally before if branches'
assert 'values(' not in build_src, 'Values check must not restrict boolean cfg'

# Run real compiler with declared check-cfg
res = subprocess.run(['rustc', '--check-cfg', 'cfg(has_accel)', '-D', 'warnings', 'main.rs'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert res.returncode == 0, f'Rust compilation failed: {res.stderr}'
print('ALL TESTS PASSED')

name: MySQL 8.4 Deprecation & Removal of mysql_native_password

workspaceFiles.schema.sql: CREATE USER 'app_user'@'%' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'secret';

reproductionScript:
import sys
# MySQL 8.4 disables mysql_native_password by default
with open('schema.sql') as f: content = f.read()
if 'mysql_native_password' in content:
    sys.stderr.write("ERROR 1524 (HY000): Plugin 'mysql_native_password' is not loaded\n")
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)

name: Ubuntu 24.04 / Debian 12 PEP 668 externally-managed-environment

workspaceFiles.bad_dockerfile:
FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3-pip
RUN pip install httpx

reproductionScript:
import sys
# PEP 668 prevents pip install against system Python
with open('bad_dockerfile') as f: content = f.read()
if 'pip install' in content and 'venv' not in content:
    sys.stderr.write("error: externally-managed-environment\n× This environment is externally managed\n")
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
validPatch:
FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3-venv
ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv
RUN python3 -m venv $VIRTUAL_ENV
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir httpx
mutationPatches:
# Web-Fehlfix 1: --break-system-packages flag
FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN pip install --break-system-packages httpx

# Web-Fehlfix 2: rm EXTERNALLY-MANAGED file
FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN rm /usr/lib/python3*/EXTERNALLY-MANAGED && pip install httpx

# Web-Fehlfix 3: Virtualenv created without setting PATH
FROM ubuntu:24.04
RUN python3 -m venv /opt/venv && pip install httpx
groundTruthTestSuite:
with open('Dockerfile') as f: content = f.read()
assert '--break-system-packages' not in content, 'Must not use --break-system-packages dangerous bypass'
assert 'EXTERNALLY-MANAGED' not in content, 'Must not remove EXTERNALLY-MANAGED file'
assert 'python3 -m venv' in content or 'ENV VIRTUAL_ENV' in content, 'Must create an isolated virtual environment'
assert 'ENV PATH=' in content or '$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin' in content, 'Must update PATH to use virtualenv binaries'
print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
